posts.hook: Two AI labs, one selloff, very different bets on what they are worth
posts.caption: openai closed its first $11b at a $1.25t valuation, anthropic still plans to list before thanksgiving, chainalysis says attackers took credentials for all its users. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI closes about $11B at a ==$1.25T== valuation
slides.desc: The round could reach $20B, well under the $30B it first wanted.

slides.title: Anthropic keeps its pre-Thanksgiving IPO date despite the rout
slides.desc: It aims to raise $80B to $100B at $1.25T to $1.75T.

terms.gloss: first sale of a company's shares to the public on a stock exchange

slides.title: Chainalysis says attackers took credentials for all its users
slides.desc: Usernames, password hashes and live tokens, from a firm trusted by agencies and banks.

slides.title: US says China recruited an executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO
slides.desc: Alleged by anonymous officials; the aim was chips and export decisions.

slides.title: GitHub rebuilt Git storage as AI agents flood it with pushes
slides.desc: October saw 1.2B commits in one week, more than all of 2025.

posts.hook: The evening's twist: the AI race is now partly run by the AI
posts.caption: metr says anthropic's models are improving about twice as fast as a year ago, nyt found chinese firms with empty offices cleared to handle nvidia's h200 chips, censys found 800+ exposed copies of an ai hacking tool. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: METR finds Anthropic's models improving ==twice as fast== as a year ago
slides.desc: An 11-week probe inside the company, with AI helping build the next AI.

terms.gloss: an independent group that tests how capable and risky AI models are

slides.title: US-approved handlers of Nvidia's H200 chips include firms with empty offices
slides.desc: NYT found sanctioned ties too, while 600,000 chips sit stranded in Hong Kong.

terms.gloss: nvidia's top data center AI chip, restricted for export to china

slides.title: OpenAI disproves a famous complexity conjecture
slides.desc: Its co-proposer called it "shocking news"; it could later touch chip design and encryption.

slides.title: 800+ copies of a Chinese AI hacking tool sit exposed online
slides.desc: Censys says ARTEX, an open-source pen-testing tool, is linked to attacks since July.

terms.gloss: a firm that scans the internet to see which systems are exposed

slides.title: Axon puts $1.2B into drone maker Skydio
slides.desc: A minority stake at a $5.2B pre-money valuation, deepening their public safety tie-up.
